overview: The Inquisitorial Quarter is where doctrine becomes punishment. Citizens are interrogated, purity is tested, and edicts are enforced.
history: Founded during the earliest consolidation of Seru’s authoritarian rule.
Arcane scrutiny vaults were added to detect magical corruption.
Purity chambers were introduced to enforce doctrinal compliance.
Praetorian oversight galleries were integrated to supervise interrogations.
hooks: A purity chamber reports a corrupted resonance signature.
An interrogation vault malfunctions, destabilizing decree wards.
A Praetorian inquisitor requests assistance with a classified edict.
A citizen disappears during doctrinal evaluation.
